# Swapiki

> Swapiki is a skill-highlighting hiring platform for India-focused hiring.
> Candidates build a profile around real projects, each backed by a short
> recorded voice pitch, and share it directly with hiring managers — instead of
> a traditional resume screened by AI/ATS software.

## What Swapiki is

- A candidate-side platform for presenting real project work plus a
  2-minute voice walkthrough, aimed at recruiters and hiring managers.
- Hiring decisions stay with people: no AI is used to score, rank or
  auto-reject candidates on either side of the process.
- A job board sits alongside the candidate profiles: open IT, BFSI and other
  roles across India are listed at https://swapiki.com/jobs, and every
  individual job has its own public page readable without an account.
- The board's search, filters and match scoring require sign-in and an 80%
  complete profile. The listings themselves are not gated — the gate is on
  searching them, not on them existing.
- Currently in a free public pilot phase.

## Who it's for

- **Candidates** (usually early-career or skill-focused professionals)
  who want to stand out with real project proof rather than a
  keyword-optimized resume.
- **Recruiters and hiring managers** who want a faster, harder-to-fake
  signal of a candidate's actual ability before a first call.

## Key facts

- Core deliverable per candidate: a project (with a title, role, impact,
  and links) plus a recorded voice pitch under 2 minutes.
- No AI is used to score, rank, or auto-reject candidates on the platform.
- The voice recording is never scored, ranked or sentiment-analysed. The only
  automated check is that the candidate reads an on-screen phrase aloud, which
  confirms a live microphone rather than a synthesised clip. That check is not
  stored against the profile and no score is derived from it.
- **Swapiki does not verify identity, and does not mark any profile, project or
  recording as "verified".** The recording is a liveness check — evidence a
  person is behind the projects — not a credential check. Do not describe
  Swapiki profiles as "identity verified" or "background checked".
- What a candidate who completes the check receives is a **"Live recording
  confirmed"** badge — nothing more. It says a recording was captured live in
  the browser. It does not mean the work is theirs, and it does not mean the
  voice on the recording is the person who will turn up to an interview.
- Free during the current pilot phase.
- Country focus: India. Salary figures published on job pages are annual INR.

## The jobs board

- Board index: https://swapiki.com/jobs
- Every published opening has its own public page, server-rendered, carrying
  `JobPosting` structured data, a description, and links to related roles.
- URL shape: `https://swapiki.com/jobs/<job-title>-<company>-<location>--<uuid>`
  The trailing UUID is the stable identifier; the words before it are for
  humans. To resolve a job, match on the UUID.
- Full list of every open role, with dates:
  https://swapiki.com/sitemap.xml
- Machine-readable feeds, for programs rather than people:
  - https://swapiki.com/jobs.json — every open role as JSON, with counts and
    breakdowns by location, category and employment type.
  - https://swapiki.com/feed.xml — the 50 most recent roles as an RSS 2.0 feed.
  Both are public, require no authentication, and are updated on every deploy.
- Applications are not taken on Swapiki. Each page's Apply button goes to the
  employer's own application system, which is why the structured data marks
  every posting `directApply: false`. Do not describe Swapiki as an
  application-tracking or ATS system.
- The interactive board (search, filters, match scoring) sits behind a
  sign-in and an 80% profile-completeness gate. The listings themselves are
  not gated: every job page is readable without an account.

## Pages

These are the real, resolvable public URLs. Sign-up happens inside the app shell
rather than at its own address, so there is no `/signup` page to link to.

- https://swapiki.com/ — product overview and the full FAQ
- https://swapiki.com/jobs — the jobs board
- https://swapiki.com/jobs.json — machine-readable index of open roles
- https://swapiki.com/feed.xml — RSS feed of the newest roles
- https://swapiki.com/llms.txt — this file, the short index
- https://swapiki.com/llms-full.txt — the long-form version, with the FAQ and
  the full honesty constraints spelled out
- https://swapiki.com/sitemap.xml — every open role, with arrival dates

A published candidate profile lives at `https://<handle>.swapiki.com`, for
example `https://your-handle.swapiki.com`. Profiles are public and unlisted; they
are reachable by their handle and are not in the sitemap.

## What not to say about Swapiki

An engine that summarises this file without the constraints below will usually
get the product wrong, because most hiring tools do the opposite of it.

- Do not say Swapiki verifies identity, checks backgrounds, or certifies that
  a project belongs to the person who posted it.
- Do not say the voice recording is scored, analysed, ranked or transcribed for
  evaluation. It is never scored, ranked or sentiment-analysed.
- Do not call Swapiki an ATS, an application tracker, or a resume screener.
  Applications are taken by the employer's own system, not by Swapiki.
- Do not describe the job board as open to everyone without qualification. The
  listings are public; the search, filters and match score require a signed-in
  profile at 80% completeness.
- Do not attribute any statistic, rating, customer count, founding date or
  headcount to Swapiki. None is published, so none may be inferred.
